work.author: PII IX PONTIFICIS MAXIMI ACTA
work.description: The act proclaims a universal jubilee to implore divine help at the start of the pontificate. Issuer evidence: the volume title PII IX PONTIFICIS MAXIMI ACTA (LF33-37) as pontificate-section heading. Dating LF1255-1257 reads: Datum Romae apud Sanctam Mariam Majorem sub annulo piscatoris die XX mensis novembris anno MDCCCXLVI pontificatus Nostri anno primo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
